claims.explanation: RITA binds p53 and blocks MDM2-mediated degradation, so selective killing is driven by dependence on the MDM2-p53 axis. High MDM2 expression or upstream activating mutations (PTEN loss, BRAF/EGFR mutation) that increase MDM2 activity sensitize, whereas wild-type p53 is required; TP53 mutation, high MDM4, or high p21 confer resistance. This explains why lines with PTEN/BRAF mutations and intact or partially functional p53 are among the most killed, while lines with TP53 mutation and protective factors are less affected.
